summary: A Stugna-P crew with a guided anti-tank missile on a tripod. It kills tanks and light vehicles, but it is fragile, slow to pack up and nearly helpless against infantry that reaches it.

sections.title: Anti-tank guided missile
sections.how: Select the Stugna team and left-click an enemy vehicle, or let it fire at anything in range.
sections.body: The Stugna-P launches a guided missile at its target. It punches through tank armour and destroys light vehicles, but it is poor against infantry, cannot hit aircraft, and has a minimum range: anything that gets too close is safe from it.

sections.title: Stow and set up
sections.how: Select the team and left-click the ground; on touch, tap.
sections.body: The crew cannot walk with the launcher ready. It first stows the launcher and tripod on the operator's back, walks, then sets up again on the new spot, and only then can it fire. Give the move order before the enemy arrives, not in the middle of a duel.

sections.title: Fight from a trench
sections.how: Select the team and left-click a finished trench, or press Garrison.
sections.body: Inside a trench the crew is protected: small arms and most fire only graze it, though high explosives and thermobaric shells wear the trench down and can destroy it. It fires its missile out at vehicles. When an enemy holds the next piece of the line, the crew switches to sidearms and fights as infantry, never firing the launcher point-blank, and in a trench line it advances from piece to piece toward the enemy. Press Unload to get out.

sections.title: Garrison buildings
sections.how: Select the team and left-click a civilian building, or press Garrison.
sections.body: The crew takes cover inside and fires from the windows with more range and damage. The building changes hands to your side while they hold it and returns to neutral when they leave. A wrecked building throws them out, and one that collapses can kill them.

sections.title: Heal at the barracks
sections.how: Select damaged Stugna teams and left-click your barracks.
sections.body: They walk in and heal for free while the barracks keeps training. A patient leaves on its own when whole. If the barracks is destroyed or sold, the patients are thrown out.

sections.title: Dig trenches
sections.how: Select the soldiers, press Dig trench and left-click the ground. Drag to draw a line; Shift turns a single trench or keeps the button armed after a line.
sections.body: A squad digs a two-cell trench; more diggers finish faster. A finished trench halves the damage its infantry take, and a section with a roof protects the first two soldiers completely. Wheeled vehicles cannot cross it once it is half dug; tracked vehicles and infantry can.

sections.title: Repair bridges
sections.how: Select one or more soldiers and left-click a damaged or broken bridge.
sections.body: The soldiers walk to the bank and repair the bridge for free. Every worker adds a share, up to six; a dozer counts for three. A broken bridge opens again once it is repaired enough to carry traffic.

tips: Set it up before the enemy arrives: the crew must stow the launcher to walk and set it up again to fire.
Keep it behind a tank or in a trench; in the open it dies to the first infantry squad that reaches it.
In a trench line it fights with a sidearm at close quarters, so back it with riflemen.
It cannot hit drones or aircraft; pair it with something that can.
